aldi.name: Aldi
aldi.store: The New Jersey ALDI store aldi.us assigned (mostly Bordentown NJ; each item shows its store). A local store can't be chosen without an account.

lidl.name: Lidl
lidl.store: lidl.com online price (default region; the NJ store can't be chosen without the app). Price can vary by region; the range is shown.

amazon.name: Amazon
amazon.store: amazon.com listing price, sold by Amazon itself (no third-party sellers), as seen from a New Jersey connection. Price varies, may include shipping; the date it was read is on each card.
amazon.source: amazon.com public search and product pages
amazon.own_brands: Amazon Grocery (formerly Happy Belly / Amazon Fresh), Amazon Basics, Solimo, Aplenty

costco.name: Costco
costco.store: costco.com public prices (no login), Kirkland Signature only, bulk sizes. The price shown is the in-warehouse price costco.com displays for the warehouse it assigned from a New Jersey connection (Cherry Hill NJ); the 2-Day Delivery online price, which includes delivery, is noted beside it. Costco membership required; warehouse price may differ by location. Compared per unit.
costco.source: costco.com public search and product pages

walmart.name: Walmart
walmart.note: walmart.com shows a robot check after a couple of searches. We don't get past robot checks, so Walmart prices aren't in this preview yet.
